result:
Unit phase done.

**Result: 95 passing, 0 failing, 2 skipped (KNOWN-DEFECT), 100% line coverage (127/127), 100% branch (18/18).** Only `*.spec.ts` files touched — no application code modified.

What I did:
- **Baseline run** showed `1 FAILED, 25 SUCCESS` — `tutorial.service.spec.ts` injected `TutorialService` without `HttpClientTestingModule` (broken test, fixed in place per §5), plus three assertion-free `ApiInterceptor` specs (Karma warned "has no expectations").
- **Rewrote** `tutorial.service.spec.ts` (verbs/urls/bodies, 400/404/500 paths, empty-collection, id `0`, empty search, lazy-observable) and `api.interceptor.spec.ts` (real assertions + leading-slash, empty path, absolute `http`/`https` passthrough, header/body preservation, error propagation).
- **Added** four `*.behaviour.spec.ts` files for the drawer, details, list and add components, covering `ngOnChanges` state resets, `open` boundaries (`0`, `''`), 404-vs-500 branches, message fallbacks, payload shapes and `router.navigate` on delete.

Findings reported (3 app-level, 2 analysis):
1. **high** — the `/api/health` + "API: ok" footer story is unimplemented; nothing in `src/` references health, and `app.component.html:8-13` has no status element.
2. **medium** — `tutorial-details.component.ts:58,74` read `res.message` with no null guard (the drawer guards with `res && res.message`); an empty 200/204 throws, so the published flag and confirmation never update. Kept as a skipped red spec.
3. **low** — `tutorial.service.ts:40` interpolates the raw search term, so `'ng & forms'` produces a mis-parsed query string. Kept as a skipped red spec.

Output written to `.test-gen/outputs/01-unit.json`, plan at `.test-gen/plan/unit.md`.

tool_input.command: for f in src/app/services/tutorial.service.ts src/app/models/tutorial.model.ts src/app/interceptors/api.interceptor.ts src/environments/environment.ts src/app/components/tutorial-drawer/tutorial-drawer.component.ts; do echo "=== $f"; cat -n "$f"; done

cat src/app/app.component.html; echo "=== spec"; cat src/app/app.component.spec.ts; echo "=== env"; cat src/environments/environment.ts; which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; echo "CHROME_BIN=$CHROME_BIN"
ls /home/runner/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; ls /opt/google/chrome 2>/dev/null; command -v google-chrome-stable google-chrome chromium 2>/dev/null; echo done

sed -i "s/^    xit('falls back to a default message when the api returns an empty body'/    it('falls back to a default message when the api returns an empty body'/" src/app/components/tutorial-details/tutorial-details.component.behaviour.spec.ts && sed -i "s/^    xit('url-encodes a search term/    it('url-encodes a search term/" src/app/services/tutorial.service.spec.ts && npx ng test --watch=false --browsers=ChromeHeadless > .test-gen/t2.log 2>&1 || true; grep -A4 "FAILED$" .test-gen/t2.log | head -30; tail -2 .test-gen/t2.log
